ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is heavily skewed toward low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey), with approximately 5-10% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixels localized in scars and edge mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base across both lobes; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (rosette scars) scattered semi-randomly; dense high-intensity white/grey mottling concentrated at the distal tips and along portions of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both trailing edges; left lobe shows more pronounced jagged peaks (amplitude ~5-15 pixels); right lobe shows smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct upward-sweeping convexity on the leading/outer edges, transitioning to a slight concave curve as the trailing edge approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes, characteristic of historical barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One thin, diagonal high-intensity line on the upper-right lobe; several faint, shorter unaligned linear disruptions near the base of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textural and pigmentation anomalies at distal tips, appearing as heavily mottled white/grey regions; multiple circular scarring events across the entire visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Lower-central region near the peduncle is partially occluded by high-intensity white water splash/droplet pixels, obscuring surface details in that localized area.
